text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Passing the 400-meter mark!!
Which Umamusume will burst to the front?!

text_block_list.name: Opera O & Pokke
text_block_list.text:
ââHAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHH!!!!
ââAAAAAAARRRRRRRGGGGHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —Haha...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: OOOOOOOOOOOOHHHHHH!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In the lead is Stay Gold!!
Stay Gold crosses the line in first place!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Stay Golllld! Congrats!!
Stego really is the strongest after all!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Stego's at the pinnacle of this era!!
Thank you for proving it to us all!!
――Stego!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Pokke...—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...It's frustrating, but today was a complete defeat.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'll admit it.
Right now, it really is your era.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Even so, it's only temporary.
Stego-san.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"For this Supreme Overlord knows no limits.
There is no end. Therefore—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The spectators will one day bear witness!
To the dawning of the Overlord's era!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: (Ah... I see――――)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(It's missing from my journey.
The things that should have been there, both before and after that "Japan Cup.")

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(That's why, to the audience...
To Opera O and Pokke... I am no longer—)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ..............................I suppose that's only natural.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(That belongs to a different world.
And the one who won today... is me.)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: —Take pride in this, Stego-san.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Right now, you are the center of the era.
I, the Supreme Overlord, guarantee it.
...If only for this fleeting moment, that is.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha—
Well, that's...... the best guarantee I could ask for.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Thank you,
Opera O, Pokke.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Because you all were truly strong...
I was able to run today, striving to surpass you.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: (That's why I'll hold my head high, and take it with me.)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(The glory I gained by defeating you all today...
and these feelings—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
It's a glory that we seized together.

text_block_list.name: Stego's Fan A
text_block_list.text: Stegooo!! Prove that you're the strongest at the Arima Kinen, toooo!!

text_block_list.name: Stego's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely be cheering for you!!
Win the Arima Kinen, too, okay?!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: "Arima Kinen"————

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, Stay Gold and I were standing in a place I had never seen before.
Was this a daydream, or—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ……It's a path.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Where Stay Gold's gaze was fixed.
There lay two paths stretching straight out into the distance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One path stretched far toward the golden horizon—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ......It's the same color.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: The end of my other-world self... that I saw in my "memories."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the other path is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It swirls into something indiscernible,
extending into a colossal chaos..."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ――...A light.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Where Stay Gold pointed,
several flickers of light could be seen
twinkling amidst the chaos.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: That is... that color is...—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ......Well, I'll just leave it be.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, right now,
I need to live up to the expectations of those who watched over me.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: "Everyone!! Thanks for cheering me on!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, amidst everyone's blessings, Stay Gold's Japan Cup drew to a close—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —That night.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Do you remember what you saw in the Winner's Circle?
choice_data_list: Yeah. But what on earth was that—
Yeah. But what on earth was that—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: I guess the time has come to choose.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Where should the destination of this journey be set?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...One of them was the path she originally aimed for.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
The place another me from another world once reached.
The edge of "memory"—the land of Hong Kong.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: And the other one is—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: A path of chaos, where anything can happen.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yet amidst that chaos...
there is a light that flickers with certainty.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Surely, that is the brilliance of those bound to me by fate.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Where they all gather in the end... is the race.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Which way do you want to go?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...The policy for this journey has remained unchanged from the very beginning."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If that is where causality converges.
If that is where the unknown chaos lies.
choice_data_list: Let's go. — To the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I am convinced.
That very race will make this journey the most exciting of all.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Right.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
……Reaching the end of those "memories" with who I am now
was something I yearned for a little, but――

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...This suits us much better.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Let us go.
—And let us enjoy it together.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen, where anything can happen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...At the convergence of woven destinies.
What awaits the traveler is—
